nodes.label: SLH-DSA-SHA2-192f Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Parameter Set
nodes.description: Fast variant parameter set for SHA2-192 instantiated Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signatures specified in NIST FIPS 205, targeting NIST Security Category 3.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Host Downstream Port Memory (HDM) Decoder Architecture
nodes.description: Hardware range decoding mechanism within CXL 3.1 root ports and switches mapping host physical address spaces to target endpoints with interleave granularity up to 16-way.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Disambiguation-Guided Morphological Generator
nodes.description: Arabic surface-form synthesis module in CAMeL Tools generating fully inflected word forms from lemma, root, and target morpho-syntactic feature specifications.

nodes.label: W3C RDF Schema 1.1 (RDFS) Vocabulary Description Language
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining data-modeling vocabulary terms including rdfs:Class, rdfs:subClassOf, rdfs:domain, and rdfs:range for structuring RDF resources.

nodes.label: Plus-Times (Standard Arithmetic) Semiring in GraphBLAS
nodes.description: Standard algebraic semiring structure where addition is arithmetic addition and multiplication is standard scalar multiplication, used for matrix-matrix reachability and count operations.
